FloatingFestival24_EFI_Parks_QuizCharact.en: Ahoy, {PlayerName}!
Prove yer knowledge about the Parks Floatin' Festival and I'll reward ya! *squawk*
FloatingFestival24_EFI_Parks_QuizCharact.cz: Dokaž své znalosti o Plovoucím festivalu Parků a já tě odměním! *skřehotání*

FloatingFestival24_EFI_Parks_QuizCharact.en: I'm ready for the quiz! Yar!
I need more time to explore!
How many different Squirrels be there on Main Street on this island?
FloatingFestival24_EFI_Parks_QuizCharact.cz: Kolik různých Veverek najdeš na ostrově Main Street?

FloatingFestival24_EFI_Parks_QuizCharact.en: Two.
Three.
Four.
Actually, I'm going to go count those Squirrels again!
FloatingFestival24_EFI_Parks_QuizCharact.cz: Vlastně si ty Veverky půjdu znovu spočítat!

FloatingFestival24_EFI_Parks_QuizCharact.en: What film be showin' in Oswald's Theater? *squawk*
FloatingFestival24_EFI_Parks_QuizCharact.cz: Jaký film se promítá v Oswaldově kině? *skřehotání*

FloatingFestival24_EFI_Parks_QuizCharact.en: The Playful Duck.
The Lucky Rabbit.
The Happy Mouse.
I changed my mind. I'm going exploring!
FloatingFestival24_EFI_Parks_QuizCharact.cz: Rozmyslel/a jsem si to. Jdu prozkoumávat!

FloatingFestival24_EFI_Parks_QuizCharact.en: Who be the captain... Er... Who be the OWNER of the restaurant at the Floating Festival?
FloatingFestival24_EFI_Parks_QuizCharact.cz: Kdo je kapitán... Ehm... Kdo je MAJITEL restaurace na Plovoucím festivalu?

FloatingFestival24_EFI_Parks_QuizCharact.en: Luigi.
Tony.
Vincenzo.
I changed my mind. I'm going exploring!
FloatingFestival24_EFI_Parks_QuizCharact.cz: Rozmyslel/a jsem si to. Jdu prozkoumávat!

FloatingFestival24_EFI_Parks_QuizCharact.en: What time is it on Main Street on this here island?
FloatingFestival24_EFI_Parks_QuizCharact.cz: Kolik je hodin na Main Street na tomhle ostrově?

FloatingFestival24_EFI_Parks_QuizCharact.en: I'm going to check the clocks on Main Street. Be back soon!
FloatingFestival24_EFI_Parks_QuizCharact.cz: Jdu si zkontrolovat hodiny na Main Street. Hned jsem zpátky!

FloatingFestival24_EFI_Parks_QuizCharact.en: How many popcorn buckets can ya find on Main Street on our fair island?
FloatingFestival24_EFI_Parks_QuizCharact.cz: Kolik kbelíků s popcornem najdeš na Main Street na našem krásném ostrově?

FloatingFestival24_EFI_Parks_QuizCharact.en: Four.
Six.
Eight.
I'm off to count popcorn buckets!
Ya passed the test! Me riches are yours!
FloatingFestival24_EFI_Parks_QuizCharact.cz: Test jsi složil/a! Mé poklady jsou tvé!

FloatingFestival24_EFI_Parks_QuizCharact.en: Seems ya made an error or two. Ya might want to go for a stroll and look around the island a bit more, matey. Come back and try again soon!
FloatingFestival24_EFI_Parks_QuizCharact.cz: Zdá se, že jsi udělal/a chybičku nebo dvě. Možná by ses měl/a projít a prohlédnout si ostrov trochu víc, námořníku. Přijď to zkusit znovu brzy!

FloatingFestival24_EFI_Parks_QuizCharact.en: Gotta go.
